parsed.name: 伪时钟时钟线
parsed.description: 伪时钟实验时序系统中的时钟输出线或时钟通道，用于向下游设备分发定时脉冲，协调数字量、模拟量等实验序列的同步运行。
parsed.description_en: A clock output line or channel in a pseudoclock-based experimental timing system. It distributes timing pulses to downstream devices and synchronizes digital, analog, and other time-sequenced laboratory operations.

actions.description: 将下游设备接入该时钟线。
actions.description_en: Attach a downstream device to this clock line.

actions.description: 获取该时钟线的时钟频率上限。
actions.description_en: Get the clock frequency limit of this clock line.

actions.description: 获取该时钟线时钟脉冲的最小高电平持续时间。
actions.description_en: Get the minimum high-state duration of the clock pulses on this clock line.

actions.description: 收集该时钟线上各输出需要变化的时间点。
actions.description_en: Collect the times at which outputs on this clock line must change.

actions.description: 将变化时间点展开为该时钟线的详细时序事件。
actions.description_en: Expand change times into detailed timing events for this clock line.

actions.description: 获取由该时钟线驱动的输出通道。
actions.description_en: Get the output channels driven by this clock line.

actions.description: 为该时钟线生成时钟脉冲序列。
actions.description_en: Generate the clock pulse sequence for this clock line.

actions.description: 生成该时钟线对应的时序控制代码。
actions.description_en: Generate the timing control code for this clock line.

actions.description: 触发该时钟线所属的时序开始运行。
actions.description_en: Trigger the timing sequence associated with this clock line.

actions.description: 执行该时钟线的配置与时序检查。
actions.description_en: Perform configuration and timing checks for this clock line.

actions.description: 判断该时钟线所属时序源是否为主伪时钟。
actions.description_en: Determine whether the timing source associated with this clock line is the master pseudoclock.

actions.description: 设置该时钟线的初始触发时间。
actions.description_en: Set the initial trigger time for this clock line.

actions.description: 按触发时间对该时钟线的时序指令进行偏移。
actions.description_en: Offset this clock line's timing instructions relative to the trigger time.
